target_customer: Product and design teams at mid-size and large companies that maintain a design system and ship code to several platforms
problem: Designers and developers re-do the same work by hand when a design changes, so design systems drift from the shipped code.
product_category: Design system platform and design-to-code tooling

founders.name: Jiri Trecak
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch (2018-03) calls co-founder Jiri Trecak a mobile app developer; prior employers and education not found.

founders.name: Oskar Koristka
founders.background_notes: Listed as a founder on the YC page; no background found.

competitors.name: Zeplin
competitors.what: Design handoff tool that turns Sketch designs into specs and assets for developers
competitors.traction_then: Widely used by product teams in this period; no figures found

technical_complexity.rationale: By March 2018 the product converted Sketch designs into native iOS, Android and React Native code and exported assets and animations. That needs plugin work across several design editors and code generators, which is standard but wide engineering for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Code generation templates and design tool plugins can be copied, though teams that store a design system and documentation in it face some switching cost. The 2018 pitch was a paid Mac app, which was easy to substitute.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The 2022 funding coverage says the product overlaps with Figma, GitLab, GitHub and custom workflows. Supernova stayed independent and raised later rounds.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (2018-03) reports founders saying the tool saves up to 50 percent of developer time on repetitive UI work, and the team had earned revenue from client mobile app work before building it.

branding.domain_note: Operates on supernova.io; earlier product was called Supernova Studio. No purchase history found.
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches of Supernova 3 exist; no merch or fan community found.

identity.logo: Not described in sources I opened
identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct and product focused, with emoji in headings (2026 homepage)

brand_strength.rationale: Name is a common word shared with many unrelated brands, search results for the brand were dominated by other Supernova firms, and no mascot or community asset was found.

pivots.from: Sketch to native mobile code (Supernova Studio Mac app)
pivots.to: Design system platform with documentation, delivery and later AI agents
pivots.why: Product scope grew from code export to design system management; exact pivot date not stated by a source, 2018 is the earliest product description.

outcome_analysis: Supernova started as a bootstrapped Prague agency spinoff selling a Mac app that turned Sketch designs into mobile code, took a small round from Credo Ventures in 2018, and joined YC in Winter 2019. It widened into a design system platform, raised a 4.8 million dollar seed in 2022 and a 9.2 million dollar Series A in 2025, and remains active with enterprise customers. Growth has been slow and capital efficient rather than explosive.
notes: Aggregators disagree on totals ($9.2M, about $22M) and one lists a 2021 seed of $1.1M led by Wing; single source, so not recorded as a round. Series A is dated September 2025 in one summary and 1 October 2025 on the parsers.vc page. The Zeplin competitor source is dated October 2019, about nine months after the batch start, and is the only dated rival source found; the 2018 TechCrunch piece names no competitors. Founding year 2016 from the YC page; CB Insights says 2018.
